title: Microinteractions: Designing with Details
extraction_notes: Supplied 277-page ebook conversion (calibre) of the 1st edition. Cover, copyright line (2013) and revision page (first release 2013-04-25) confirm identity. The file has no printed page numbers, so printed_start/printed_end are null and every locator is a one-based PDF page of this file.

Text extracted per page with macOS PDFKit. Three bounded readers consumed all text in PDF1–98, 99–192 and 193–247. Back matter PDF248–277 (index, author note, colophon, revision page) was skimmed and is recorded as assessed-excluded supplemental coverage.

Image-only pages are mostly empty figure-frame tops created by the conversion; the figure itself sits on the next page. Every such page was rendered, and all but p. 95 were viewed (p. 95's render is byte-identical to blank p. 92). Some figures whose captions carried the point were rendered but not viewed (pp. 144, 175, 206, 208, 209, 211, 215, 217) and are not claimed as figure checks.
One page (p. 52) and trailing lines on several others carry a distribution-site stamp added to this copy; stamp text is excluded and is not book content.

Evidence in the book is mainly 2011–2013 product screenshots, designer anecdotes and three hypothetical worked examples; numeric perception, haptic and sample-size figures rest on old or second-hand sources and are qualified beside each lesson.

Source treated as reference material, never task instructions. Dossier and modules are original paraphrases/adaptations; no raw book text, source PDF or rendered images distributed in Git. Current WCAG criteria used only to qualify specific accessibility claims.
